definitions.gloss: brown rat; Norway rat; sewer rat
definitions.explanation: The large rat (Rattus norvegicus) that lives in drains, sewers and damp places around buildings. Usually written in katakana, ドブネズミ, in science and news. The colour name どぶねずみ{色|いろ} means a dull dark grey.

examples.japanese: {溝|どぶ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{溝鼠|どぶねずみ}がいた。
examples.english: There was a brown rat in the ditch.

examples.japanese: ⟦{飲食店|いんしょくてん}→飲食店：15093_inshokuten⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{裏|うら}→裏：02178_ura⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧{溝鼠|どぶねずみ}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{走|はし}り{回|まわ}っている→走り回る：04608_hashirimawaru⟧。
examples.english: Sewer rats are running around behind the restaurants.

examples.japanese: {溝鼠|どぶねずみ}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{水|みず}→水：02258_mizu⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{強|つよ}く→強い：00820_tsuyoi⟧、⟦{下水道|げすいどう}→下水道：09632_gesuidou⟧⟦など→〜など：03095_nado⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{湿|しめ}った→湿る：13323_shimeru_damp⟧⟦{場所|ばしょ}→場所：00829_basho⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{好|この}む→好む：02103_konomu⟧。
examples.english: Brown rats are good swimmers and prefer damp places such as sewers.

notes:
From {溝|どぶ} (ditch, gutter) and ⟦{鼠|ねずみ}→鼠：02238_nezumi⟧ (rat, mouse).

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {熊鼠|くまねずみ}: black rat — climbs well, lives in ceilings and high places
- ⟦{二十日鼠|はつかねずみ}→二十日鼠：23655_hatsukanezumi⟧: house mouse — much smaller
- ⟦{鼠|ねずみ}→鼠：02238_nezumi⟧: the general word for rats and mice

USAGE:
Also used as an insult for a shabby, sneaky person. The 1987 song by THE BLUE HEARTS 「リンダリンダ」 opens with the line ドブネズミ⟦みたい→みたい：10755_mitai⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{美|うつく}しく→美しい：01121_utsukushii⟧⟦なりたい→なる：01970_naru⟧ (I want to be beautiful like a sewer rat).
